verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's own marketing says it 'automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team' and helps 'disposition alerts more intelligently', which suggests in-product agents work alert-driven cases. That is a single thin marketing mention with no documentation of how the agent investigates alerts or writes notes. Missing for 10: documented agent investigation of transaction alerts, agent-generated review notes or narratives, first-party feature docs for the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to investigate transaction alerts and prepare review notes

citations.quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.
Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently.
